questionText:
下圖顯示兩副眼鏡 X 和 Y 的處方，其焦強分別為 $-2.5\ \text{D}$ 和 $+1.25\ \text{D}$。配戴眼鏡時，不計眼鏡與眼的距離。以下哪些正確？
(1) 配戴 X 的人是近視的。
(2) 配戴 X 的人不戴眼鏡時，遠點在眼前 $40\ \text{cm}$。
(3) Y 的鏡片是發散透鏡。
The figure shows the prescriptions of two pairs of glasses X and Y, of powers $-2.5\ \text{D}$ and $+1.25\ \text{D}$ respectively. Neglect the distance between the glasses and the eye. Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) The wearer of X is short-sighted.
(2) Without glasses, the far point of the wearer of X is $40\ \text{cm}$ in front of the eye.
(3) The lens of Y is a diverging lens.

聽覺閾強度為 $1.0\times10^{-12}\ \text{W m}^{-2}$。以下哪些正確？
(1) 強度為 $1.0\times10^{-6}\ \text{W m}^{-2}$ 的聲音，強度級為 $60\ \text{dB}$。
(2) 聲音的強度加倍時，強度級增加約 $3\ \text{dB}$。
(3) 強度級為 $0\ \text{dB}$ 的聲音完全沒有聲能。
The threshold of hearing is $1.0\times10^{-12}\ \text{W m}^{-2}$. Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) A sound of intensity $1.0\times10^{-6}\ \text{W m}^{-2}$ has an intensity level of $60\ \text{dB}$.
(2) When the intensity of a sound is doubled, its intensity level increases by about $3\ \text{dB}$.
(3) A sound of intensity level $0\ \text{dB}$ carries no sound energy at all.

下圖是腹部 A 型超聲波掃描的顯示，回波 X、Y、Z 分別來自脂肪與肌肉的分界面、肝臟前緣及肝臟後緣。以下哪些正確？
(1) 其他條件相同時，分界面兩邊聲阻抗相差越大，反射的超聲波比例越大。
(2) 由 Y 和 Z 之間的時間間隔及超聲波在肝臟中的速率，可求得肝臟的厚度。
(3) 回波 Z 較小，表示肝臟後緣的分界面吸收了大部分超聲波。
The figure shows the display of an A-scan of the abdomen. Echoes X, Y and Z come from the fat–muscle boundary, the front surface of the liver and the back surface of the liver respectively. Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) Other things being equal, the larger the difference in acoustic impedance across a boundary, the larger the fraction of ultrasound reflected.
(2) The thickness of the liver can be found from the time interval between Y and Z and the speed of ultrasound in the liver.
(3) Echo Z is smaller because the boundary at the back of the liver absorbs most of the ultrasound.

在內窺鏡中，用來傳送影像的光纖束必須是相干光纖束。這是因為
In an endoscope, the fibre bundle used to carry the image must be a coherent bundle. This is because

options.A:
相干光纖束令光傳播得較快。
a coherent bundle makes light travel faster.
options.B:
各光纖在光纖束兩端的相對位置相同，影像才不會被打亂。
the relative positions of the fibres are the same at both ends of the bundle, so the image is not scrambled.
options.C:
相干光纖束可傳送較多光線照明。
a coherent bundle carries more light for illumination.
options.D:
相干光纖束可避免光在光纖中發生全內反射。
a coherent bundle prevents total internal reflection in the fibres.

questionText:
醫生要即時觀察病人心臟瓣膜的開合及血液流動，而不想令病人受電離輻射。最合適的方法是
A doctor wishes to observe in real time the opening and closing of a patient's heart valves and the flow of blood, without exposing the patient to ionizing radiation. The most suitable method is

options.A:
電腦斷層掃描（CT）。
computed tomography (CT).
options.B:
X 射線照片。
an X-ray radiograph.
options.C:
放射性核素造影。
radionuclide imaging.
options.D:
超聲波掃描（包括多普勒超聲波）。
ultrasound scanning (including Doppler ultrasound).

questionText:
軟組織和骨對某單色 X 射線的線性衰減係數分別為 $0.20\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ 和 $0.50\ \text{cm}^{-1}$。要使一塊骨對這 X 射線的衰減與 $4.0\ \text{cm}$ 厚的軟組織相同，骨的厚度 $x$ 應是多少？骨的半值厚度又是多少？（見下圖）
The linear attenuation coefficients of soft tissue and bone for a certain monochromatic X-ray beam are $0.20\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ and $0.50\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ respectively. What thickness $x$ of bone attenuates this X-ray beam by the same amount as $4.0\ \text{cm}$ of soft tissue, and what is the half-value thickness of bone? (See the figure.)

為顯示一條直徑 $0.50\ \text{cm}$ 的血管，向血液注入含碘的造影劑，使血管中物質的線性衰減係數由 $0.20\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ 增至 $5.0\ \text{cm}^{-1}$。對於直穿血管直徑的 X 射線，注入造影劑前與注入後透射強度之比約為多少？
To show a blood vessel of diameter $0.50\ \text{cm}$, an iodine contrast medium is injected into the blood, raising the linear attenuation coefficient of the contents of the vessel from $0.20\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ to $5.0\ \text{cm}^{-1}$. For X-rays passing straight across the diameter of the vessel, what is the approximate ratio of the transmitted intensity before injection to that after injection?

碘-131 用於治療甲狀腺疾病。它的物理半衰期為 $8.0$ 日，在甲狀腺中的生物半衰期為 $12$ 日。甲狀腺內碘-131 的放射強度降至原來的 $\dfrac{1}{16}$ 需時多久？
Iodine-131 is used to treat thyroid disease. Its physical half-life is $8.0$ days and its biological half-life in the thyroid is $12$ days. How long does it take for the activity of iodine-131 in the thyroid to fall to $\dfrac{1}{16}$ of its initial value?
